welcome.title: Light dey? Tell your neighbours.
welcome.body: Report in two taps whether there is light in your area. Together we see the real picture: when light comes, when it goes, and how many hours your area really gets.

consent.before: By tapping Let's go you agree to our
consent.after: . You confirm you are 18 or older, or have a parent or guardian's permission.

spot.title: Where do you want to track light?
spot.useLocation: Use my location to suggest areas
spot.locationNote: Used only on your phone to suggest nearby areas. We never store or share where you are.
spot.locationDenied: No problem. Search for your area instead.
spot.locationNone: We found no areas close to you yet. Search for yours instead.
spot.noResults: No area found. Try another spelling, or browse by state.
spot.noAreasYet: We have not opened {lga} yet. Light Dey? starts in Abuja and Lagos, and more places are coming.
spot.addSpot: My street or estate is not listed
spot.didYouMean: Did you mean one of these?
spot.exists: That spot already exists in this area. Choose it from the list.
spot.label: Save it as
spot.full: You already saved 3 spots. Remove one from the home screen first.
spot.error: Could not save. Please try again.

extras.title: A few optional details
extras.bandHelp: You can find it on your electricity bill or meter. Not sure? Skip it.
extras.alreadySet: This spot already has these details. Thank you!
extras.notify: Get a ping when light comes back
extras.notifyNote: Light alerts are coming soon. iPhone users will need to add the app to the Home Screen first.
